MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Blink doorbell feels like a useful next addition because it extends my existing camera setup to front-door video and alerts.",
    "An Echo Dot and smart plug offer practical new uses alongside my Fire TV devices: voice control and controlling a lamp."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another HD Fire TV Stick adds little because I already have a 4K stick and a Fire TV television.",
    "Earbuds, extra storage, and a USB cable do not address a current need; owning electronics does not mean I need more accessories.",
    "The camera bundle and multiple Echo speakers overlap with equipment I already own or would choose individually."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in Fire TV seems to have been taken as a reason to suggest more streaming devices, even when they offer no useful addition.",
    "My connected-home purchases seem to invite several similar speakers and cameras, although I would choose only what fills a specific gap."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "What I already own matters: a doorbell adds a monitoring use, while another streaming stick largely duplicates existing equipment.",
    "I am selective about additions and would start with one speaker and a doorbell rather than several overlapping devices."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You understood my interest in connected-home security and television, but sometimes confused useful additions with more of what I already have."
}
